scope: Three source root causes. No generated output, suppression, dependency or unrelated changes.

rootCauses.name: Drawer deep traversal initialization
rootCauses.impact: Deep menu traversal ran on every render although React discarded all but its first result. Repeated work grows with menu size. No production latency measurement claimed.
rootCauses.fix: Pass a pure initializer function to useState. Preserve the existing mount-time openedPath rather than changing route synchronization behavior. Development Strict Mode may still invoke the initializer twice.
rootCauses.tests: Regression instruments nested menu reads and demonstrates traversal stops after initialization while the original openedPath reference is preserved after a changed slug. It failed before the change.

rootCauses.name: Category checkbox selected-ID lookups
rootCauses.impact: Each category searched the same selected array on every render. Larger selections incur repeated scanning; small lists have negligible costs and initial Set creation can be slightly slower.
rootCauses.fix: Memoize a Set by selected-array identity and use has. Preserve duplicates in the actual selected array, store updates, removal behavior, and the existing non-matching behavior for array-valued tag references.
rootCauses.tests: Regression proves no selected-array includes calls during checkbox rendering, correct checked flags, adding a category and removing all copies of an ID. It failed before the change.

rootCauses.name: Divider styling/rendering complexity
rootCauses.impact: Maintenance improvement, with no intended visual or interaction change. Orientation, dimension and color branches obscured the simpler child rendering path. Two computed style objects were never used.
rootCauses.fix: Separate cohesive Divider prop/style calculation from icon/body rendering and remove unused style calculations. Keep defaults and style precedence unchanged.
rootCauses.tests: Five tests pass before and after: default horizontal/stack modes, configured horizontal/vertical dimensions and color/alignment, icon/body rendering and custom-color fallback.

recipeReview: Fetched current recipes with no-cache curl and read evidence boundaries. Runtime tests prove repeated traversal/lookups; the lookup benchmark includes Set construction and an approximate heap estimate. Divider extraction separates meaningful styling from rendering rather than introducing arbitrary component boundaries. No suppressions added.
grouping: Three independent source root causes, one diagnostic each.

benchmark.method: Equivalent selected.includes versus Set.has loops over synthetic category values; Set construction included on every measured after call although the component memoizes it. Five warmups, 25 samples, median. Approximate heap increase uses 100 retained sets divided by 100 after GC; noisy estimate. No production latency or browser rendering benchmark.

validation.tests: 7 pass across 3 files; 2 performance regressions failed before changes; Divider preservation suite passes before/after
validation.typecheck: Final tsc --noEmit passes. An earlier run reported an unrelated grid type-portability error which was no longer present in the final workspace check. No grid code changed in this pass.
validation.eslint: Zero errors; one pre-existing unused eslint-disable warning in DrawerContentList remains untouched.
validation.format: Prettier check and git diff --check pass
validation.overallCount: 76 to 72; three source removals belong to this pass. Generated Storybook artifacts changed between scans outside this work, with a net reduction of one diagnostic.
validation.limitations: No production build, real-browser visual verification or live-site benchmark. UI tests use mocked boundaries with happy-dom/server rendering.

followUp: Remaining component complexity, tag-membership loops and small initialization warnings.
Review lookup findings carefully: substring searches are not Set membership and tiny breakpoint lists may not justify conversion.
